state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 3 (decode, and the cap) is in progress.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

The image component is embedded, typed into every compile and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). libwebp 1.6.0 is prebuilt into `extensions/image/libwebp/libwebp.a` and pinned by `SOURCE.json`; the image crate does not link it yet (Stage 4's lossy WebP encoder).

`[image] max_pixels` is on disk: `System`, `Reload`, `"24M"` = 2²⁰·24 pixels in the size grammar, `false` and zero refused at boot (`nvs_config::image` module doc, `rule:core-classes/image-pixel-cap`). Nothing reads it at run time yet. The only export implemented is `info`; `run` and `variants` return `runtime`.

items.text: **Decode inside the guest, with the cap checked from the header first** (`rule:core-classes/image-format-roster`, `rule:core-classes/image-pixel-cap`) — `run` at `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:94` decodes every first-wave format and throws `RuntimeError` over the cap before a buffer is allocated, and `ParseError` for bytes that are no image or a malformed IFD. A new `[[test]] name = "image_decode"` in `crates/nvs-ext/Cargo.toml:82` with its fixtures, generated under `extensions/image/fixtures/`.

**The cap reaches the guest** (`rule:core-classes/image-pixel-cap`) — the host passes `nvs_config::image::in_force` (`crates/nvs-config/src/image.rs:59`) into the call, and a call's own `maxPixels` may only lower it; the test `an_image_over_max_pixels_is_refused_before_a_buffer_is_allocated` raises it and the same bytes pass.

backlog: Turning off wasmtime's default features would remove zstd, ittapi and gdbjit C code from the binary; the ledger rows in `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts` `C_DEPENDENCIES` record them as unreachable meanwhile (`rule:packaging/a-c-dependency-answers-two-questions`).
libwebp's source pin was taken from the tarball as downloaded; Google publishes a `.asc` signature beside it that no tool checks yet (`tools/nv/cmd/webp-lib.ts`).
